definitions.gloss: 60th birthday, completion of the sexagenary cycle
definitions.explanation: The celebration of one's 60th birthday, marking the completion of the traditional Chinese zodiac cycle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{還暦|かんれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
{還暦|かんれき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{還暦|かんれき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦ちゃんちゃんこ→ちゃんちゃんこ：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: People wear a red vest for their 60th birthday.

notes:
{還暦|かんれき} literally means "return to the calendar" — it marks the completion of one full 60-year cycle of the Chinese zodiac (12 animals × 5 elements), after which the cycle starts again.

TRADITIONS:
The celebrant traditionally receives a ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦ちゃんちゃんこ→ちゃんちゃんこ：noentry⟧ (red padded vest). Red symbolizes rebirth, as the person begins a "new" cycle of life.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {還暦|かんれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to reach one's 60th birthday
- {還暦|かんれき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧: 60th birthday celebration
- {還暦|かんれき}⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧: 60th birthday gift/celebration

OTHER MILESTONE BIRTHDAYS:
- ⟦{古希|こき}→古希：29070_koki⟧ (70), ⟦{喜寿|きじゅ}→喜寿：29071_kiju⟧ (77), ⟦{傘寿|さんじゅ}→傘寿：noentry⟧ (80)
- ⟦{米寿|べいじゅ}→米寿：noentry⟧ (88), ⟦{卒寿|そつじゅ}→卒寿：noentry⟧ (90), ⟦{白寿|はくじゅ}→白寿：noentry⟧ (99)
